data.review_body:
I purchased a barbecue through Temu from one of their marketplace sellers, Home Interiors Hinckley. The product was advertised as a "Kamado Grill" and described as "insulated", creating the clear expectation that it would have the heat retention and performance characteristics of a genuine Kamado cooker.
The item I received is simply a thin sheet-metal barbecue with very poor heat retention. It does not perform like a Kamado grill and the description is misleading. The design also imitates the appearance of a traditional Kamado, which further gives consumers the wrong impression.
My main disappointment is with Temu itself. As the marketplace operator, Temu should have proper checks in place to ensure that third-party sellers are not using misleading descriptions to sell products that do not match the advertising.
Despite providing evidence and explaining the issue, Temu has not offered a satisfactory solution or taken responsibility for the misleading listing on its platform.
Customers should be aware that buying through Temu's marketplace does not necessarily mean that product descriptions have been properly verified.
